scenario.title: When recovery is unavailable
scenario.question: What are the surcharge rules?
scenario.description: Repair fails on a policy answer. With no transaction record to summarize, the turn is refused.

trace.question: What are the surcharge rules?

steps.answer: Send surcharge_amount in minor units with the authorization request. Surcharges apply to credit cards only, are capped at 3 percent, and must be disclosed before payment. Debit and prepaid cards cannot be surcharged. (source: https://wiki.example.com/surcharge) A processing fee of 12.34 was also charged.
